entry.name: jit.group-gl
entry.digest: Messages and attributes common to the GL group
entry.description: Jitter GL objects have a common set of attributes for how to do their 3D rendering, and messages related to drawing. This includes things like position, rotation, scaling, blending mode, texture, lighting, material properties and other useful tasks.

arguments.name: context-name
arguments.description: Explicitly sets the OpenGL rendering context by name. If this is absent, the Jitter GL object will use the next higherorobject in the patcher hierarchy as the rendering context.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.digest: The anchor position in local space (default = 0. 0. 0.)
attributes.description: The anchor position in local space (default = 0. 0. 0.). Allows for offsetting the local 3D origin around which transforms are applied.

attributes.name: anim
attributes.digest: The instance anim name (default = UID)
attributes.description: The name of aobject that handles all spatial transforms for this instance (default = UID). The default value references an internal object, but can be overridden by setting to the name of an existing externalinstance. This allows for more advanced control of the spatial transform.

attributes.name: animmode
attributes.digest: Determines which space theandmessages will affect the this object.
attributes.description: Determines which space theandmessages will affect the position and orientation of this object (default = parent).local = Rotate relative to local axisparent = Rotate relative to parent axisworld = Rotate relative to world axis

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: antialias
attributes.digest: Antialiasing flag (default = 0)
attributes.description: Antialiasing flag (default = 0) On some hardware, the blend_enable attribute must also be enabled for antialiasing to work.

attributes.name: auto_material
attributes.digest: Automatic material attributes flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Automatic material attributes flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, and lighting is enabled for the object, the diffuse and ambient material components for the object will be set to the object's color, and the specular and emissive lighting components are disabled.

attributes.name: automatic
attributes.digest: Automatic rendering flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Automatic rendering flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, rendering occurs when the associated jit.gl.render object receives a bang message

attributes.name: aux_color
attributes.digest: The auxiliary color in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.)
attributes.description: The auxiliary color in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.) The list elements should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: axes
attributes.digest: x/y/z axis rendering off/on (default = 0)
attributes.description: x/y/z axis rendering off/on (default = 0)

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: blend
attributes.digest: The named blending mode
attributes.description: The named blending mode. The possible values are:add =1 1multiply =2 1screen =4 1exclusion =4 5colorblend =3 4alphablend =6 7coloradd =3 1alphaadd =6 1

attributes.name: blend_enable
attributes.digest: Blending flag (default = 0)
attributes.description: Blending flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, blending is enabled for all rendered objects.

attributes.name: blend_mode
attributes.digest: The source and destination planes associated with the blend mode (default = 6 7)
attributes.description: The source and destination planes associated with the blend mode (default = 6 7) Blend modes are specified in the form src_blend_mode dst_blend_mode. The supported modes are:0 = zero1 = one2 = destination color3 = source color4 = one minus destination color5 = one minus source color6 = source alpha7 = one minus source alpha8 = destination alpha9 = one minus destination alpha10 = source alpha saturate

attributes.name: camera
attributes.digest: The camera position in 3D space (default = 0. 0. 2.)
attributes.description: The camera position in 3D space (default = 0. 0. 2.) Camera position is specified as a set of floating point numbers that correspond to a camera position with respect to the x, y, and z axes.

attributes.name: capture
attributes.digest: The name of a texture to be rendered to
attributes.description: The name of a texture to be rendered to - e.g.will capture to.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: The draw color in the form red green blue alpha (default = 1. 1. 1. 1.)
attributes.description: The draw color in the form red green blue alpha (default = 1. 1. 1. 1.) The list elements should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: cull_face
attributes.digest: Face culling mode (default = 0 (no culling))
attributes.description: Face culling mode (default = 0 (no culling))0 = no culling1 = cull back faces2 = cull front faces

attributes.name: depth_clear
attributes.digest: Depth buffer clear flag (default = 0)
attributes.description: Depth buffer clear flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, the depth buffer is cleared before rendering the object.

attributes.name: depth_enable
attributes.digest: Depth buffering flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Depth buffering flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, depth buffering is enabled.

attributes.name: depth_write
attributes.digest: Depth write flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Depth write flag (default = 1). When the flag is set, writing to the depth buffer is enabled. This will have no effect ifis turned off.

attributes.name: dest_dim
attributes.digest: Destination dimensions width height (default = jit.gl.render destination dimensions)
attributes.description: Destination dimensions width height (default = jit.gl.render destination dimensions)

attributes.name: drawto
attributes.digest: The named drawing context in which to draw (default = none)
attributes.description: The named drawing context in which to draw (default = none) A named drawing context is a named instance of a jit.window, jit.pwindow, or jit.matrix object that has an instance of the jit.gl.render object associated with it.

attributes.name: enable
attributes.digest: Enable flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Enable flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, drawing is enabled.

attributes.name: far_clip
attributes.digest: The far clipping plane distance in 3D world (default = 100.)
attributes.description: The far clipping plane distance in 3D world (default = 100.)

attributes.name: filterclass
attributes.digest: The name of this object's pick filter class
attributes.description: The name of this object's pick filter class (default = default). This controls the visibility of objects to theandobjects. In order to select this object, the filterclass value must be in the picking object'slist.

attributes.name: fog
attributes.digest: The amount of fog effect (default = 0.)
attributes.description: The amount of fog effect (default = 0.)

attributes.name: fog_params
attributes.digest: The fog parameters in the form red green blue alpha density start end (default = 0. 0. 0. 0. 0. 0. 0.)
attributes.description: The fog parameters in the form red green blue alpha density start end (default = 0. 0. 0. 0. 0. 0. 0.) The list's color elements should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: layer
attributes.digest: Object layer number (default = 0)
attributes.description: Object layer number (default = 0) When in automatic mode, the layer number determines the rendering order (low to high). Objects in the same layer have no guarantee which will be rendered first.

attributes.name: lens_angle
attributes.digest: The lens angle of the OpenGL camera (default = 45.)
attributes.description: The lens angle of the OpenGL camera (default = 45.)

attributes.name: light_ambient
attributes.digest: The color and opacity of the ambient light component in the form(default = 0. 0. 0. 1. (opaque black))
attributes.description: The color and opacity of the ambient light component in the form(default = 0. 0. 0. 1. (opaque black)) All values should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: light_diffuse
attributes.digest: The color and opacity of the diffuse light component in the form(default = 1. 1. 1. 1. (opaque white))
attributes.description: The color and opacity of the diffuse light component in the form(default = 1. 1. 1. 1. (opaque white)) All values should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: light_global_ambient
attributes.digest: The color and opacity of the global ambient light component in the form(default = 0.2 0.2 0.2 1.)
attributes.description: The color and opacity of the global ambient light component in the form(default = 0.2 0.2 0.2 1.) All values should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: light_position
attributes.digest: The position of the light source in XYZ coordinates and the light type (default = 1. 1. 1. 0.)
attributes.description: The position of the light source in XYZ coordinates and the light type (default = 1. 1. 1. 0.)When the last number is 0., t The light is treated as a directional source if 0. is the final number. Otherwise, diffuse and specular lighting calculations are based on the actual location of the light in eye coordinates, and attenuation is enabled.

attributes.name: light_specular
attributes.digest: Color and opacity of specular light component (default = 1.
attributes.description: Color and opacity of specular light component (default = 1. 1. 1. 1. (opaque white)) The first three floats in the range 0.-1. specify the RGB components of the specular light color. The fourth float (also in the range 0.-1.) specifies opacity.

attributes.name: lighting_enable
attributes.digest: Lighting enabled flag (default = 0)
attributes.description: Lighting enabled flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, lighting is calculated.

attributes.name: line_width
attributes.digest: The drawing line width (default = 1.)
attributes.description: The drawing line width (default = 1.)

attributes.name: lookat
attributes.digest: 3D position at which the camera is pointed (default = 0. 0. 0.)
attributes.description: 3D position at which the camera is pointed (default = 0. 0. 0.)

attributes.name: mat_ambient
attributes.digest: The ambient light material property in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.)
attributes.description: The ambient light material property in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.) The list elements should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: mat_diffuse
attributes.digest: The diffuse light material property in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.)
attributes.description: The diffuse light material property in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.) The list elements should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: mat_emission
attributes.digest: The material emission property in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.)
attributes.description: The material emission property in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.) The list elements should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: mat_specular
attributes.digest: The specular light material property in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.)
attributes.description: The specular light material property in the form red green blue alpha (default = 0. 0. 0. 0.) The list elements should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: matfile
attributes.digest: The Jitter material file to apply
attributes.description: The Jitter material file to apply (.jitmtl)

attributes.name: matrixoutput
attributes.digest: Matrix output mode (default = 0)
attributes.description: Matrix output mode (default = 0)0 = issue render commands1 = output geometry matrices2 = output geometry matrices with local transform applied

attributes.name: name
attributes.digest: The instance name (default = UID)
attributes.description: The instance name (default = UID)

attributes.name: near_clip
attributes.digest: The near clipping plane distance in 3D world (default = 0.1)
attributes.description: The near clipping plane distance in 3D world (default = 0.1)

attributes.name: ortho
attributes.digest: Orthographic projection mode (default = 0)
attributes.description: Orthographic projection mode (default = 0)0 = orthographic projection off (perspective projection)1 = orthographic projection on, using lens angle2 = orthographic projection on, ignoring lens angle

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: point_mode
attributes.digest: Point drawing mode to use when rendering points (default = circle)
attributes.description: Point drawing mode to use whendrawing primitive (2) is enabled (default = circle).

choices.digest: Draw point as square with depth scaling
Draw point as circle with depth scaling
Allow writing toin custom vertex shader

attributes.name: point_size
attributes.digest: The draw point size (default = 1.)
attributes.description: The draw point size (default = 1.)

attributes.name: poly_mode
attributes.digest: Polygon rendering modes (default 0 0)
attributes.description: Polygon rendering modes (default 0 0) Rendering modes are expressed in the form frontface backface. Supported rendering modes are:0 = render as filled polygons1 = render as lines2 = render as points

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: The 3D origin in the form x y z
attributes.description: The 3D origin in the form x y z (default = 0. 0. 0.)

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: quat
attributes.digest: The current rotation as a quaternion
attributes.description: The current rotation as a quaternion(default = 0. 0. 0. 1.). A quaternion is a mathematical construct that is a four dimensional vector, and can be visualized as a rotation around an arbitrary axis. Quaternions are a useful representation of an orientation in 3D space.

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.digest: The angle of rotation and the xyz vector about which the rotation is performed.
attributes.description: The angle of rotation and the xyz vector about which the rotation is performed in the form rotation-angle x y z (default = 0. 0. 0. 1.)

attributes.name: rotatexyz
attributes.digest: Sets the current rotation in degrees
attributes.description: Sets the current rotation to the concatenation of rotations about the positive x, y, and z axes, also known as Euler angles (default = 0. 0. 0.). The default order is yzx and can be changed with therotate_order attribute. Angles are expressed in degrees.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.digest: The 3D scaling factor in the form x y z
attributes.description: The 3D scaling factor in the form x y z (default = 1. 1. 1.)

attributes.name: shader
attributes.digest: The name of the shader to be applied (default = none)
attributes.description: The name of the shader to be applied (default = none)

attributes.name: shadow_caster
attributes.digest: Shadow caster flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Shadow caster flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, object will cast shadows.

attributes.name: shininess
attributes.digest: The material shininess value (default = 16.0)
attributes.description: The material shininess value (default = 16.0) The value should be a float in the range 0.-255.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: smooth_shading
attributes.digest: Smooth shading flag (default = 0)
attributes.description: Smooth shading flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, smooth shading is used when rendering.

attributes.name: tex_map
attributes.digest: Mode for automatic generation of texture coordinate controls (default = 0)
attributes.description: Mode for automatic generation of texture coordinate controls (default = 0)0 = no coordinates are generated.1 = OpenGL's texture generation is used with mode GL_OBJECT_LINEAR. This applies the texture in a fixed orientation relative to the object.2 = OpenGL's texture generation is used with mode GL_SPHERE_MAP. This can be used to create a reflection effect.3 = OpenGL's texture generation is used with mode GL_EYE_LINEAR. This applies the texture in a fixed orientation relative to OpenGL's eye coordinates.Modes 1 and 3 are affected by the value of the tex_plane_s and tex_plane_t attributes listed below.

attributes.name: tex_plane_s
attributes.digest: The texture generation coefficients a b c d that apply to tex_map modes 1 and 3.
attributes.description: The texture generation coefficients a b c d that apply to tex_map modes 1 and 3. (default = 1. 0. 0. 0.)The four coefficients define a plane used to generate the s texture coordinate, which corresponds to the x axis of the texture image. If the tex_map mode is 1, s = ax + by + cz + dw, where x, y, z, and w are the homogeneous coordinates of the vertex.

attributes.name: tex_plane_t
attributes.digest: The texture generation coefficients a b c d, which apply to tex_map modes 1 and 3.
attributes.description: The texture generation coefficients a b c d, which apply to tex_map modes 1 and 3. (default = 0. 1. 0. 0)The four coefficients define a plane which is used to generate the t texture coordinate, which corresponds to the y axis of the texture image.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: texture
attributes.digest: The name of the texture to be applied (default = none)
attributes.description: The name of the texture to be applied (default = none). If multiple textures are specified, uses multi-texturing.

attributes.name: transform_reset
attributes.digest: Modelview and projection transform reset flag (default = 0)
attributes.description: Modelview and projection transform reset flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, the modelview and projection transforms are set to the identity transform before rendering the object. This is useful for sprite or billboard overlays, or automatic scaling to window size. The transform_reset flag modes are:0 = do nothing (default)1 = proportional orthographic glOrtho(-aspect, aspect, -1.0, 1.0, near_clip, far_clip);2 = orthographic normalized glOrtho(-1.0, 1.0, -1.0, 1.0, near_clip, far_clip);3 = proportional perspective with near clip = 0.001 gluPerspective(lens_angle, aspect, 0.001/*near_clip*/, far_clip);4 = normalized perspective with near clip = 0.001 gluPerspective(lens_angle, 1.0, 0.001/*near_clip*/, far_clip);

attributes.name: up
attributes.digest: The 3D vector towards which the top of the camera points (default = 0. 1. 0.)
attributes.description: The 3D vector towards which the top of the camera points (default = 0. 1. 0.)

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: verbose
attributes.digest: Toggles printing messages to the Max Console.
attributes.description: Toggles printing messages to the Max Console.

attributes.name: viewalign
attributes.digest: View aligned transformation flag (default = 0)
attributes.description: View aligned transformation flag (default = 0)

messages.name: anim_grow
messages.description: Scale the object along each axis by the amount provided.

messages.name: anim_move
messages.description: Move the object along the axis provided, relative to the space indicated by.

messages.name: anim_reset
messages.description: Reset the local transformation attributes to their default values (position = 0 0 0, rotatexyz = 0 0 0, and scale = 1 1 1)

messages.name: anim_turn
messages.description: Rotate the object along each axis by the amount provided, relative to the space indicated by.

messages.name: draw
messages.digest: Draws the object in the named drawing destination. If theattribute is supported and set to 1, the geometry matrices are sent out the object's left outlet.
messages.description: Draws the object in the named drawing destination. If theattribute is supported and set to 1, the geometry matrices are sent out the object's left outlet.

messages.name: drawimmediate
messages.digest: Equivalent tobut ignoring any potential renderer setup
messages.description: Equivalent tobut ignoring any potential renderer setup

messages.name: export_geometry
messages.digest: Export geometry state to an external file
messages.description: Export the object's geometry state as model file with the name specified by the first argument. The second argument sets the file type (default = gltf). Available file types are(GL Transmission Format),(Stanford Polygon Library), and(Stereolithography).

messages.name: export_material
messages.digest: Export material state as a material file
messages.description: Export material state as a material file (.jitmtl).

messages.name: get_shader
messages.digest: Open the object's current JXS shader
messages.description: Open an editor window containing the object's current JXS shader.

messages.name: jit_gl_texture
messages.description: Binds the texture specified byto this object. Equivalent to setting theattribute to.
